name: Kuen Tong Industrial Co., Ltd.
summary: Kuen Tong Industrial Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells precision components in Taiwan and internationally. The company offers products and services, such as OEM and ODM component manufacturing, CNC precision machining, forging, friction-stir welding, surface treatment, clean manufacturing processes, assembly, micrometer-level measurement, joint design manufacturing, and design-for-manufacturing support. Its application areas include low-orbit satellites, AI server cooling modules, semiconductor equipment, and bicycles. The company was founded in 1997 and is based in Changhua, Taiwan.
